steps.title: 360° breathing + pelvic floor
steps.details: 5 slow 360° breaths. Then 5 × 3 s submax pelvic-floor lifts; 6–8 s full relaxation after every lift. Finish with 1 easy deep-core control set.

steps.title: Fast march / jumping jacks
steps.details: Easy primer. Keep it around RPE 6/10 — do not fatigue legs before evening gym.

steps.title: Chin tucks
steps.details: 2 × 10 controlled reps. Keep the back of the neck long.

steps.title: Wall slides
steps.details: 2 × 10. Ribs down, move only through a clean range.

steps.title: Prone Y–T–W
steps.details: 2 rounds × 6 each position. Slow and controlled.

steps.title: REST
steps.details: Move near wall for ankle rocks.

steps.title: World's Greatest Stretch
steps.details: Alternate sides with calm breathing. Use the remaining time as controlled mobility.

tuesday.label: Tuesday
tuesday.focus: Integrated movement + handstand + shoulders + biceps + triceps

steps.title: 360° breathing + pelvic floor
steps.details: 5 slow breaths → 5 × 3 s submax lifts with 6–8 s full relaxation → 1 easy deep-core control set.

steps.title: REST / stand up
steps.details: Grab one dumbbell and clear space for the clean-to-lunge.

steps.title: Single-Arm DB Clean → Front-Rack Reverse Lunge
steps.details: Alternate sides. Clean one dumbbell to the shoulder/front rack, step back into a controlled reverse lunge, stand tall, lower and repeat. Keep it smooth and athletic rather than heavy.
steps.setup: Start from a hang or low position. Keep the clean close to the body, catch softly at the shoulder, then reverse-lunge with a tall trunk.
steps.feel: Legs, hips, trunk, grip and coordination working together.
steps.avoid: No jerking, twisting or grinding. Keep about 2–3 RIR and reduce the load if the right shoulder feels pinchy in the rack position.
steps.minuteCue: Switch sides regularly and keep the clean-to-lunge sequence fluid.

steps.title: Handstand practice
steps.details: Practice wall-assisted or free attempts. Keep breathing; stop/regress if pressure or doming appears.

steps.title: Pike push-ups
steps.details: 3 × 8–12. Fit all sets into this block. Clean reps; short rests.

steps.title: DB lateral raise
steps.details: 4 × 12–20. 1–2 reps in reserve. Control the lowering.

steps.title: 360° breathing + pelvic floor
steps.details: 5 slow breaths → 5 × 3 s submax lifts → 6–8 s full relaxation each rep. No constant gripping.

steps.title: Mountain climbers
steps.details: 3 × ~30–35 s work with brief easy breathing between.

steps.title: Single-leg DB deadlift
steps.details: 3 × 8–10 / side. Hips square, neutral spine, controlled balance.

steps.title: DB pullover dead bug
steps.details: 2–3 × 6–8 / side. No abdominal doming; exhale smoothly.

steps.title: Tuck L-sit on yoga blocks
steps.details: 3 clean holds. Goal 10–20 s. Press blocks down, shoulders depressed, hips clear, knees tucked.

steps.title: Downshift breathing
steps.details: Relax pelvic floor completely and finish with calm breathing.

thursday.label: Thursday
thursday.later: Evening gym: quads + pull + hamstrings + cardio

steps.title: 360° breathing + pelvic floor
steps.details: 5 slow breaths → 5 × 3 s submax lifts with full relaxation → easy deep-core control.

steps.title: Fast high-knee march / step-ups
steps.details: Easy primer only. Save legs for evening gym.

steps.title: Open book
steps.details: 1 × 8 / side. Breathe into the upper back.

friday.label: Friday
friday.focus: Integrated carry + triceps + front abs + mobility

steps.title: 360° breathing + pelvic floor
steps.details: 5 slow breaths → 5 × 3 s submax lifts + 6–8 s full relaxation → 1 easy deep-core control set.

steps.title: REST / stand up
steps.details: Grab one dumbbell for the suitcase march.

steps.title: Suitcase March + Opposite Knee Drive
steps.details: Hold one dumbbell at your side like a suitcase. March slowly, driving the opposite knee up while staying tall. Switch the loaded hand halfway.
steps.setup: Stand tall with ribs stacked over pelvis. Keep the dumbbell close to one thigh and lift each knee without leaning away from the weight.
steps.feel: Obliques, deep core, grip, hip flexors and pelvic stability working together.
steps.avoid: Do not side-bend, rush or hold your breath. Use a load you can control without trunk compensation.
steps.minuteCue: Switch the dumbbell to the other hand and keep the pelvis level.

steps.title: REST / set dumbbells
steps.details: Keep one or two dumbbells ready for the push-ups.

steps.title: Close-grip DB push-ups
steps.details: 3 × 8–15. Grip dumbbells, elbows relatively close, controlled reps.

steps.title: DB triceps kickback
steps.details: 3 × 12–20 / arm. Upper arm stays fixed; squeeze at full extension.

steps.title: Hollow body hold
steps.details: 3 × 20–30 s. Keep lower back controlled; regress if doming.

steps.title: Supported hip airplanes
steps.details: 2 × 5–6 controlled reps / side. Use a wall or other stable support. Hinge slightly on one leg, then slowly open and close the pelvis. Keep the standing knee controlled.

steps.title: Seated forward fold
steps.details: 2 controlled holds. Relax into range; do not bounce.

steps.title: 360° breathing + pelvic floor
steps.details: 5 slow 360° breaths → 5 × 3 s submax pelvic-floor lifts with full 6–8 s relaxation → 1 easy deep-core control set.

steps.title: DB squat-to-press / thruster
steps.details: 3 × 8–10. Squat and flow directly into the overhead press. Controlled conditioning, not failure; keep about 2–3 RIR.

steps.title: Tuck L-sit on yoga blocks
steps.details: 3 clean holds, 10–20 s target. Straight arms, push the blocks down, lift the knees high. Progress leverage only when holds stay clean.

steps.title: Half-Kneeling 1-Arm DB Shoulder Press
steps.details: 3 × 8–12 / arm. One knee down, opposite foot forward. Keep ribs stacked over pelvis and resist rotation while pressing.

steps.title: Strict Alternating / Supinating DB Curl
steps.details: 4 × 8–12. Main biceps hypertrophy block. Full elbow extension, strong supination, no torso swing. Rest enough to keep quality; finish around 1–2 RIR.

steps.title: REST
steps.details: Switch to neutral grip and clear space for lunges.

steps.title: Reverse Lunge + Hammer Curl
steps.details: 3 × 8–10 / side. Step back into a controlled reverse lunge and add a neutral-grip hammer curl. Treat it as integrated movement, not a max-load leg exercise.

steps.title: DB Halo + Shoulder Mobility
steps.details: Slow controlled halos in both directions, then use any remaining time for relaxed shoulder mobility. Keep ribs and pelvis steady; the weight circles the head, not the torso.

sunday.label: Sunday
sunday.later: Optional swim or Zone 2 outside the 30-minute mobility timer

steps.title: Calm 360° breathing
steps.details: 5–8 slow breaths. Pelvic floor fully relaxes on inhale.

steps.title: Cossack squat / adductor mobility
steps.details: 2 × 6 / side. Stay in a comfortable range.

steps.title: Doorway pec + child's pose side reach
